name: All For Climate
summary: Belgian non-profit that hosts European citizen groups without a legal entity, so they can receive donations and grants in euros.

evidence.quote: You are a collective, citizen initiative or movement working towards a more sustainable and just future.
We welcome a broad range of efforts that support ecological and social well-being. The activities of your collective have a non-profit purpose.
We created a non-profit in Brussels that acts as a fiscal host for groups working toward a more sustainable and just future.
We created a non-profit in Brussels that acts as a fiscal host for groups working toward a more sustainable and just future.

projects.value: Citizen groups and movements doing ecological or social work, not for profit

evidence.quote: We welcome a broad range of efforts that support ecological and social well-being. The activities of your collective have a non-profit purpose.
You are based in Europe. Since the bank account is based in Belgium, you can only collect euros.

value.note: for groups with no legal entity of their own

evidence.quote: The goal of All for Climate is to enable unincorporated groups of people to be able to receive and spend money in a transparent way. If your group already has a legal entity, then you don't need All for Climate. You cannot use All for Climate as a way to channel the money to another legal entity

fees.value: 6% of donations for small groups: fewer than 15 donations a year and a budget under €1000

evidence.quote: HOST FEE A. DONATIONS Pricing depends on the size of your collective: Small Collectives (fewer than 15 donations per year and an annual budget under €1000) have a host fee of 6%.

fees.value: 8% of donations for large groups: more than 15 donations a year and a budget above €1000

evidence.quote: Large Collectives (more than 15 donations per year and an annual budget above €1000) have a host fee of 8%. The cheapest way to donate is via manual bank transfer. If a donor gives €10, €9.40 or €9.20 will be added to the collective's balance. 6% or 8% goes to All For Climate to cover operating costs

fees.value: 8% or 10% on grants, in two categories

evidence.quote: A4C needs to sign final reports 8% 10% fee

fees.value: The grant fee depends on the workload

evidence.quote: A4C will deduct a grant administration fee based on the workload involved.

fees.value: Card and PayPal fees on top

evidence.quote: When donors use automatic payments or PayPal, additional transaction fees apply. These fees are charged by Stripe (credit cards) or PayPal

value.note: Your group writes and submits the application; All For Climate signs the agreement and holds the money.

evidence.quote: Collective Designs and submits the grant application, informs A4C, leads the project, complies with reporting All For Climate (A4C) Provides supporting documents, signs agreements, reviews compliance, holds and transfers funds

value.note: freelancers can be paid for a defined task

evidence.quote: As a collective, you cannot hire someone on behalf of the fiscal host, but you can hire a freelancer for a well defined task, for a defined amount of time.

conditions.value: At least two administrators, with a gender balance

evidence.quote: When you apply, add at least a second person as an admin of your collective. We advice a team of 3 or 4 administrators. Make sure you have a gender balance in the administrator team.

conditions.value: Never apply for a grant in All For Climate’s name without permission

evidence.quote: Do not apply for grants using A4C's name as the applicant entity without permission.

conditions.value: Join its general assemblies, 2 to 3 times a year

evidence.quote: You are willing to participate in the general assemblies of AllForClimate, organised 2 to 3 times a year.

steps.value: Apply on its Open Collective page, with a second administrator

evidence.quote: Apply on https://opencollective.com/allforclimate/apply and add at least a second administrator.
In this 45 minute call we meet face to face, we answer questions and help you launch you collective. After this call, we approve your application.
